hac_policy.T_definition: number of complete eligible daily origins
hac_policy.selection: deterministic pre-result automatic rule; no manual or post-result variants

inference_contract.full_model: y_t ~ intercept + beta_baseline * baseline_t + beta_candidate * candidate_feature_t

candidates.reason: Static contract valid; not selected because the finalist family favors lower relation exposure.

candidates.outcome_semantics: one future cross-sectional hourly dispersion observation at the next daily origin; not an aggregate, average, or maximum over 24h

timing.outcome: completed hourly return vector closing at t+24h

candidates.missing_data: any missing or duplicate source row blocks the origin
candidates.materiality_domain: feature SD > 0 and outcome SD > 0; otherwise BLOCKED_INVALID_STANDARDIZATION_DOMAIN

candidates.feature: DOWNSIDE_SHARE_t = sum_{i,k in prior 24h, r_i,k<0}(r_i,k^2) / sum_{i,k in prior 24h}(r_i,k^2)
candidates.outcome_semantics: next 24 hourly panel return observations beginning t+1h
candidates.missing_data: any missing or duplicate source row blocks the origin
candidates.materiality_formula: (SSE_REDUCED - SSE_FULL) / SSE_REDUCED, where SSE_REDUCED is outcome ~ intercept + PANEL_RV24_t and SSE_FULL adds DOWNSIDE_SHARE_t

classification_contract.support: beta_candidate > 0 AND raw_p_two_sided exists AND holm_adjusted_p <= 0.05 AND materiality_pass = true
classification_contract.no_support: all preconditions pass AND support predicate is false; significant negative beta remains HISTORICAL_SCREEN_NO_SUPPORT
classification_contract.blocked: any precondition fails OR materiality domain invalid; scientific numeric fields and p-values are null

multiplicity.policy: Holm step-down FWER alpha 0.05; blocked candidates retain p=null and remain in denominator
